sentence_1_it: Tom si fece male al ginocchio sinistro durante l'allenamento, così John dovette giocare al posto suo.
sentence_1_en: Tom hurt his left knee during practice, so John had to play the game in his place.

sentence_1_it: Non ha fatto tutti quegli allenamenti pesanti per niente - ha vinto il primo premio.
sentence_1_en: He had not gone through all that hard training for nothing – he won first prize.
